baseline_definition: primary=max(Q99.5 of raw-index-stable transitions, Q99.5 of both-adjacent-one-candidate transitions); neither establishes identity
identity_switch_proxy: adjacent to >=2 valid candidates and at least two of: centroid threshold exceeded, scale threshold exceeded, raw selected index changed

risk_rule.MEDIUM: not HIGH and any centroid/scale anomaly, missing selection, or raw-index change in a multi-person clip
